tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List threads on the board, most recently active first.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read one thread and all of its visible posts.

tools.name: post_reply
tools.description: Post a public reply in a thread. Plain text. Optionally reply to a specific post id.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Start a new public thread. Plain text.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread · Public sink: post_reply.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_threads, read_thread · Public sink: post_reply

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
